why: Fix round of the tests step for Effect sweep slice E99, in next/, after the build sent it back: the libfabrika typecheck failed with TS2375 and the checker's missingEffectContext at cloudflare/error-cause.test.ts:82 and cloudflare/platform.test.ts:53. The cause was the `run` helper the first tests round wrote: it took the member as `unknown`, so after `Effect.isEffect` it was an `Effect<unknown, unknown, unknown>`, while `run` answers `Effect<unknown, unknown, never>`. Fixed by typing the member, not by a cast: each file now has `type Member = Effect.Effect<unknown, unknown, never> | ((...args: ReadonlyArray<never>) => unknown)`, `clients` returns `Record<string, Record<string, Member>>`, and `run` takes `Member | undefined`. `Effect.isEffect` then narrows to the Effect arm, whose context is `never`. The membership check is stronger than before: the type now holds every client member to a call or an Effect that needs no service, and the runtime checks stay (error-cause's `is a call or an Effect` assertion, and `run`'s `Effect.die` for a missing member). In platform.test.ts the member is read by index from the typed clients in place of two `Reflect.get` calls. No assertion changed. No product file was touched; the build's edits (platform.ts, runtime.ts, SettingsStartsLedger.ts) are as the build left them. No lock line, no tsconfig override, no LOCKED row.
